name: Rishiri (Japan)
description: A red field charged at the centre with the Rishiri town emblem in white and green: a white stylised wave and disc with a green mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Rishiri, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 May 1968.

features.role: Rishiri town emblem — a white stylised wave and disc with a green mountain
